limit_order_match_in_progress.meaning: a limit order matching (partial or full) is being processed through _processLimitBidOrder or _processLimitAskOrder
limit_order_match_in_progress.checkpoint: before the zero-cost trade guard evaluation during limit order matching

matched_amounts_disjoint_bits.meaning: the matched base amount and matched quote amount have no overlapping 1-bits (bitwise AND of the two amounts is zero)
matched_amounts_disjoint_bits.checkpoint: before the zero-cost trade guard evaluation during limit order matching

zero_cost_guard_triggered.meaning: the zero-cost trade guard triggers (fires) during limit order matching
zero_cost_guard_triggered.checkpoint: at zero-cost trade guard evaluation during limit order matching

one_side_receives_without_sending.meaning: one side receives tokens without sending any tokens
one_side_receives_without_sending.checkpoint: at zero-cost trade guard evaluation during limit order matching

traders_encounter_unexplained_failures_o.meaning: traders, especially algorithmic ones using round numbers, encounter unexplained failures

assumptions: The zero-cost trade guard is evaluated during limit order matching processing.
The matched base and quote amounts are observable quantities at guard evaluation time.

unresolved.description: The report does not quote the exact zero-cost check expression or its operands, so the relation between the guard trigger and the 'one side receives without sending any' condition is represented by grounded Boolean observables rather than a numeric formula.
Report does not specify whether matched amounts are caller-supplied inputs or derived from order state, so the disjoint-bits condition is encoded as a single grounded Boolean.

limitations: The intent's 'only when' is encoded as a conjunction of guard-triggered and one-side-receives-without-sending in the relation; the report does not provide a numeric definition of the zero-cost condition.
The impact is potential; the outcome symbol records the reported unexplained-failure occurrence without asserting inevitability.
Caller identity and authorization for triggering limit order matching are not stated and are not encoded.
